decisions.executionNote: Raise and orient both open grippers downward with small continuous elbow-up motion; inspect object geometry before descending.
Retry initial downward orientation at reduced angular and translation increments after zero-step IK rejection.
Align downward above the two wooden animal toys, left arm over the left toy and right arm over the lion, maintaining separation.
Use wrist views to refine centering on cow and lion; descend cautiously with open grippers to establish grasp height.
Finish short descent around wooden toys, close both grippers, pause, then test retention with a small vertical lift.
Lift both closed grippers vertically to verify the wooden toys are retained and clear basket rims.
Lion is visibly retained; carry it over the right half of middle basket. Cow remained on table, so reopen and recenter left arm for a narrower grasp.
Replan from interrupted poses with smaller right-arm motion and slightly lower carry height; left descends centered over the cow.
Lower right carry pose to avoid the tight high configuration before moving inward. Close left around the now narrow, aligned cow.
Test-lift the cow while translating retained lion to the middle basket's right interior, with closed grippers.
Both toys appear retained. Lower and shift lion inward in smaller increments to stay continuous; bring cow toward the middle basket from the left.
Release lion inside the middle basket and withdraw right. Cow slipped during transport; reopen left and reacquire it lower at its new table location.
Withdraw right with reduced increments after continuity rejection. Grasp cow lower around its body rather than lifting only the upper edges.
Allow cow grasp to finish before a slow test lift. Move right toward the nearer yellow car, correcting toward a vertical grasp orientation.
Verify cow retention with vertical lift. Raise and rotate right gripper to grasp the yellow car across its short width.
Carry visibly lifted cow slowly toward the middle basket. Finish aligning the right gripper perpendicular to the yellow car's length and descend.
Cow slipped again; reapproach farther toward its body and restore vertical orientation. Close aligned right gripper around the yellow car and test lift.
Close fully on the cow's body and lift after settling. Carry the retained yellow car outward toward the right basket at rim-clearance height.
Both objects remain visibly between the fingers. Carry cow to the middle basket from the left and yellow car to the right basket without crossing arms.
Ease both retained objects over their assigned basket front rims using small increments; right car needs additional outward centering.
Objects slipped at the front rims. Withdraw from the tight high poses and reapproach; next carry will tilt fingers forward to clear rims without pushing the elbow limit.
Retry withdrawal from near-singular right pose with 1 mm initial increments, gradually increasing only after moving away.
Recenter lower over the cow behind the front rim and the fallen yellow car; close left only after the approach.
Correct the rejected tensor without compensating for unexecuted motion. Fine-center cow and close; withdraw right from rim.
Lift and tilt the cow forward to gain rim clearance without extending left elbow. Unwind right wrist and retreat from its constrained configuration.
Gain vertical clearance before moving cow past the basket wall. Restore right gripper to a neutral downward attitude while backing away.
Use a conservative bridge toward the last accepted right attitude to recover continuity, then unwind slowly; left gains clearance.
Raise retained cow vertically while keeping its forward tilt. Center the right gripper across the remaining upright yellow car and descend cautiously.
Carry elevated cow over the middle basket's front edge with its forward reach. Close right gripper on the second yellow car and test-lift.
Release cow over the middle basket and withdraw left. Raise the retained yellow car and tilt its carry pose forward for safe basket access.
Cow and lion are visible inside middle basket. Move tilted yellow-car grasp over right basket; withdraw left to clear the shared center.
Release yellow car well inside right basket. Prepare left to stage the red car at the center and right to retrieve the remaining yellow car.
Fine-align open grippers over the red car and side-resting yellow car; descend with upright attitudes and separate workspaces.
Close on each car after short final centering; pause before test lifts to judge actual retention visually.
Lift both cars. Stage red car at the center-front with left EE remaining left of center; raise and tilt yellow car for right-basket transport.
Stage the retained red car at center-front for the right arm, keeping left EE on its own side. Yellow car slipped; reopen and approach it again.
Withdraw left after staging the red car. Correct the remaining yellow car grasp using its wrist-image offset, lower, and close fully.
Settle and test-lift the right yellow-car grasp before transporting. Return left to a neutral overhead waiting pose for receiving chocolates.
Yellow car was not retained. Reopen and center lower on its body using observed wrist-image displacement, keeping left clear.
Fine-center the yellow car at the current lower height, then close and settle without lifting prematurely.
Lift the centered yellow car with fully closed grip and add forward tilt before carrying toward the right basket.
Keep the current grasp attitude fixed and lift to clear the basket rim, verifying the yellow car follows before further lateral transport.

Lower open fingers around the elevated car while maintaining the forward tilted attitude; inspect centering before closing.

Release the second yellow car inside the right basket, then withdraw right toward the staged red car and gradually restore a downward grasp.

Fine-center right fingers on the red car using a small wrist tilt and translation, staying on the right side; close and settle.

Close the centered purple-chocolate grasp, settle at a slightly deeper height, then make a small vertical retention test.

Allow closure to finish, then lift and tilt the purple chocolate leftward without translating across center; inspect retention before release.
